general_information.Description: Main objective: This course aims to equip students with the knowledge of resources, administer assets and several key procedures of housekeeping cleanliness process. -Description: Housekeeping management examines the role of supervisory function in housekeeping management such as inventory & equipment management, characteristics of materials, linen & laundry management, cleaning functions, the technical details of cleaning a room and control of supplies and equipment. -Teaching method: lecture, discussion, project based learning, group work
general_information.StudentTasks: Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend more than 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Comply with the time and regulation - Professional grooming - Respect and protect school asset. - Strongly communication and teamworking.

description: Main objective: This course aims to equip students with the knowledge of resources, administer assets and several key procedures of housekeeping cleanliness process. -Description: Housekeeping management examines the role of supervisory function in housekeeping management such as inventory & equipment management, characteristics of materials, linen & laundry management, cleaning functions, the technical details of cleaning a room and control of supplies and equipment. -Teaching method: lecture, discussion, project based learning, group work

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To describe the role of the housekeeping department in hotel operations, and explain the importance of effective communication between housekeeping department and other departments
To list and describe criteria for selection of materials and equipment for the hotel, for example, walls, floorings, beddings, linen, carpets, etc.
To operate the key procedure of cleaning and inspecting guest rooms, public areas and others, as well as able to demonstrate a working knowledge of the procedures.
To explain usage of various tools used to plan and organize the housekeeping department – staffing guide, area inventory lists, frequency schedules, performance standards and productivity standards.
To utilize various techniques to manage inventories effectively
To utilize various methods to control expenses in the housekeeping department
To operate the method of protecting property from damage and risk of insect
To demonstrate highly cooperation and discipline the team, instructor and school regulation
To communicate english fluently and professtionally in working place
To understand the responsibility of executive housekeeping and how to manage efficiently deparmental human resource

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on topics of studied units
assessments.Grading Guide: Presentation in class and submission via email or anycourse supporting platfrom
assessments.Note: Four or five students per group. Groups and groups ideas are determined on the third session of the course. Work will be break down into stages and examined during the course. Final work to be submitted prior to the presentation of the topic.All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in both soft and hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission Evaluation will be based on both presentation and written report (reccommded 30%, 70% accordingly)
Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots Attendance check at any time during course
